title: The 5 levels of Claude Code mastery
description: Most people using Claude Code are stuck at level 1 and do not even know it. Level 1 is a giant global CLAUDE.md and a few slash commands. Level 5 is a 24/7 daemon on your machine spinning Claude Code and Codex sessions up and down at will, messaging you on Telegram from anywhere, optimizing their own skills off every transcript overnight, running as actual employees in your business with full observability. In between is splitting context into project files, wiring MCP and scheduled crons, and a shared knowledge base your whole framework evolves from. Where are you on the five levels? Link in bio.
transcript: Are you a master of Claude code? Well, here are the five levels of Claude code mastery. Number one, you have a nice global claw.md built up of over 2,000 lines of different insights you've gleaned from the different by coding projects that you've done. Maybe some slash commands to help you automate those simple tasks you do on a daily basis. Level two, you've realized context is king, so you've divided that global claw.md file into a bunch of project level claw.md files that have less than 200 lines, and you've actually customized specific information into skills within each of those projects that are each dedicated to a different project you're working on in your life. Level three is in each of those specific projects you set up different MCP servers or CLI tools to connect them to external services or softwares you use in your life, and you use slash schedule to actually set up cron job workflow automations that actually trigger Claude code to wake up throughout the day in those projects and execute work for you autonomously. Level four, you've set up a shared knowledge base that all of your Claude code sessions write to and read from, so that all of their learnings can be stored in one centralized place, and your entire agentic coding framework can actually evolve on its own. You might also have scheduled workflows scraping GitHub for trending repositories, having your agents autonomously pull those different packages, test them out, and see if they would be useful for your stack. You also have scheduled workflows iterating through PRs and reviewing code for you while you sleep, so you're actually shipping code overnight even though you're not working. Level five, you have a 24/7 service running on your computer like a daemon that can actually manage and spin up and spin down Claude code and Codex sessions at will. You've connected these sessions to the messaging app of your choice like Slack or Telegram, so you can send any of these sessions messages wherever you are in the world throughout the day. You've set up 24/7 skill optimization and memory management loops that go through all of your session transcripts after every day, extract interesting findings, store those in memory or in your knowledge base, and actually iterate and optimize skills overnight based on failings that your agents had that day. At this point these agents can function as employees for you, actually accomplishing work in your business. They have full observability and auditability, so you can make sure that their outputs are good quality. If you're somewhere in that list and you want to get to level five mastery, I have full video courses on each stage of that progression, as well as plug-and-play systems that allow you get to level five with actual AI employees running your businesses for you. All of it's hosted in my school community. The link is in my bio, and I would love to see you there.
